# Mulberry Flowers

Mulberry Flowers is a pale blue unicorn mare with golden-orange hair and purple eyes, usually seen among the students at Twilight Sparkle's School of Friendship in G4 *Friendship Is Magic*. Her flower-bunch cutie mark is shared with another background design. The amusing thing about her is that she occasionally appears with wings as well as her horn.

- Appearance and continuity: [Unicorn character index](https://mlp.fandom.com/wiki/List_of_ponies/Unicorn_ponies) records her debut in *School Daze – Part 1* (S8E1), at approximately 6:53 according to its episode index, and subsequent appearances in *School Raze*, *Best Gift Ever*, *She's All Yak*, and *A Horse Shoe-In*. The listed debut time is not independently video-verified.
- Naming: Mulberry Flowers appears to be a fandom/catalog name, not a verified spoken or merchandise name. Summer Meadows is another name used by fans, as shown in this [2025 fan-art post](https://www.reddit.com/r/mylittlepony/comments/1ikki75/summer_meadows_gets_scared_by/). The original naming event and artist were not established.
- Speaking status: Apparently a background, non-speaking character; no individual dialogue or voice actor was verified.
- Wings: The [alicorn reference](https://mlp.fandom.com/wiki/Alicorns?page=1) documents her occasional winged design. This appears to be an animation inconsistency rather than an established transformation or royal identity.

## Important moments

No plot-changing decisions or individual dialogue could be verified. These two visual oddities are her most distinctive documented appearances, rather than character-defining actions.

- Unexpected wings — [A Matter of Principals (S8E14)](https://tubitv.com/tv-shows/200165176/s08-e14-a-matter-of-principals): she is reported to appear with both horn and wings during the school episode. Timestamp unavailable.
- Wings again — [What Lies Beneath (S8E22)](https://tv.apple.com/us/episode/what-lies-beneath/umc.cmc.1tu2o3k30981bbfqm67cm05pu?showId=umc.cmc.3ujevsytv3nqn8uolyrrgws8j): the same unusual design is reported a second time. Timestamp unavailable.

Verification limits: The wiki's indexed text was accessible, but direct page retrieval was blocked. No independently verified direct character image or attributed show still was available; the fan-art post above is provided as a contextual reference instead.
